dialogue.text: K'a bɛɛ, remote kura ka sabu fɛ, mɔgɔ tɛ sɔrɔ ka bana.
dialogue.translation: And indeed, remote work is good, a person doesn't stay in the office.

dialogue.text: K'a bɛɛ, remote kura jɛ fɛ, mɔgɔ tɛ sɔrɔ ka bana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kan mɔgɔ tɛ mana, kura ka sabu dɔn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Saba ka fɛ, remote kura jɛ bɛɛ.
dialogue.translation: Time is good, remote work is indeed.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: K'a bɛɛ, mɔgɔ sɔrɔ ka bana k'a kura.
dialogue.translation: And indeed, a person stays in the office and works.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kɛlɛ sira bɛɛfɛ fɔlɔ, kɛ mɛn bɔ kɔnɔ tɛ?
dialogue.translation: This truth is really difficult, and what should we do with it?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.text: Kɛlɛ sira kɔnɔ bɛɛfɛ, mɛn bɔ tɔgɔ kɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sɛbɛn, mɛn bɔ kɛlɛ sɔrɔtɔ kɔnɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kɛ mɛn bɔ kɛlɛ sɔrɔtɔ kɔnɔ, bɛɛfɛ.
dialogue.translation: And we should take this responsibility with it, really.

scenario: Talking about urban vs rural living
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Bambara

vocabulary.note: Refers to a large group of people

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tɔgɔ kɔnɔ, kɔlɔn yɛrɛ yɛrɛ, nka sɔnali kɔnɔ sɛbɛn bɛ yɛ.
dialogue.translation: In the city, there is a lot of noise, but in the village, there is peace.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: N bɛɛ, tɔgɔ kɔnɔ jɔli tɔɔrɔ, sɔnali kɔnɔ sɛnɛ tɔɔrɔ.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and in the city, things develop quickly, in the village, things develop slowly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mɔgɔw ye filiw tɔgɔ kɔnɔ, amma nye fili sɔnali kɔnɔ.
dialogue.translation: People prefer the city, but I prefer the village.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tɔgɔ kɔnɔ tumu yɛrɛ yɛrɛ, sɔnali kɔnɔ mɔgɔw bɛɛ yɛrɛ.
dialogue.translation: In the city, there is a lot of crowd, in the village, there are fewer people.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sɔnali kɔnɔ, mɔgɔw maa sɛbɛn bɛ yɛ, tɔgɔ kɔnɔ kɔlɔn yɛrɛ yɛrɛ.
dialogue.translation: In the village, people live in peace, in the city, there is a lot of noise.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nka, tɔgɔ bɛɛ sɔnali, yala mɔgɔ fili tɔgɔ kɔnɔ.
dialogue.translation: Still, both the city and the village have their advantages, but most people prefer the city.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sɛnɛ tɔɔrɔ sɔnali kɔnɔ, jɔli tɔɔrɔ tɔgɔ kɔnɔ.
dialogue.translation: Things develop slowly in the village, quickly in the city.

dialogue.text: O fò, bɛε sòrò k'àntigi k'àrè fò lalabu.

dialogue.translation: First doing, connecting, ensuring, resulting—they also do it in the system.

scenario: Reflecting on a life-changing experience
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Bambara

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mɛn saba bɔyɔ fɛ wuli ye, kɛlɛ mɛn tɛ mɔgɔ min bɛ zɔ dɔgɔ jɔli.
dialogue.translation: My life has already changed, and I’m not the same person anymore.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oho, wuli bɔyɔ yɛrɛ fɛ kɔlɔ nin, a maa se ka mɛn fɛ?
dialogue.translation: Oh, life changes deeply over time, what happened to you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mɛn zɔ fɛ dɔgɔ min mɛn tɛ mɔgɔ sɔrɔ, kɛlɛ mɛn wuli bɔyɔ jɔli.
dialogue.translation: I went on a path where I wasn’t myself, but my life changed for the better.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Wuli bɔyɔ fɛ kɔlɔ nin, mɛn mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka a fɛ?
dialogue.translation: Life changes over time, how did it affect you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mɛn wuli bɔyɔ yɛrɛ, kɛlɛ mɛn saba tɛ mɔgɔ min bɛ zɔ.
dialogue.translation: My life changed deeply, and I’m already not the same.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A maa se ka mɛn fɛ, wuli bɔyɔ jɔli fɛ kɔlɔ nin?
dialogue.translation: What happened to you, how did life change for the better over time?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mɛn zɔ fɛ dɔgɔ jɔli, kɛlɛ mɛn wuli bɔyɔ yɛrɛ.
dialogue.translation: I went on a good path, and my life changed deeply.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kanu bɛɛ, humor b'a sira kan kelen ye fɔ jamana bɔ mɔgɔ sira.
dialogue.translation: In stories, humor often makes people laugh and is very good for communication.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eee, amma humor tɔgɔ bɛɛ, a filisɛgnin kɔnɔ tɛ fɔ mɔgɔ wɛrɛ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: K'a tun ani, humor b'a mɔgɔ filisɛgnin k'a tɛ fɔ tumu bɔ a kan.
dialogue.translation: That's true, humor can help people understand the message you're conveying.

dialogue.translation: In stories, humor makes people laugh, but it also helps them understand the message you're conveying.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eee, humor tɔgɔ bɛɛ, a y'a mɔgɔ filisɛgnin k'a tɛ fɔ tumu bɔ a kan.
dialogue.translation: Yes, with humor, people can understand the message you're conveying better.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: That's true, humor makes people laugh, but it also helps them understand the message you're conveying.
